About the Property

A private canvas for large ideas.

Wild Ones LLC presents the Koa’s Events property through a different lens: not weddings or small social events, but a production-minded venue for professional organizers building concerts, dance events, festivals, retreats and branded experiences.

Positioning

The property becomes part of the production.

The goal is not to force every event into a fixed ballroom diagram. Wild Ones is being developed as a configurable production ground where the audience environment, backstage workflow, bar operations, vendor placement, technical footprint and arrival sequence can be planned together.

The current large-format planning target is up to 350 guests or ticket holders. Working staff, performers, vendors and production personnel are counted separately during event planning.
